## A + B Problem

http://acm.hdu.edu.cn/showproblem.php?pid=1000

```cpp
/*written by czk*/
#include <stdio.h>

int main() {
    int a, b;
    while(scanf("%d%d", &a, &b) != EOF)
        printf("%d\n", a+b);
}
```

```cpp
//written by czk
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int a, b;
    while(cin >> a >> b)
        cout << a+b << endl;
}
```
